title: •Plastoid Armor
caption: •Plastoid Armor (V)
game_text: Deploy on your non-droid character. Your Interrupts with “back” in title are destiny = 5 and are Used Interrupts. Your characters are immune to Bad Feeling Have I. During opponent’s move phase, may ▲ an Interrupt with “back” in title.
lore: Luke and Han took the armor suits from fallen stormtroopers and used them as both protection and disguise to penetrate the detention cell block aboard the Death Star.

notes: Unique. Printed base is a Premiere Utinni Effect; slip banner EFFECT, no grabber box. Curly double quotes around “back” (twice), curly apostrophe in opponent’s; slip prints ▲ where the stub expands it. No immunity icon. The wiki base page 'Plastoid Armor' is the printed archive face (PC errata is a separate page). The 745 px Premiere-L-plastoidarmor.gif is tagged D-E1 (PC errata face, different game text) — downloaded to src/vs11/14-Premiere-L-plastoidarmor.gif for art only; the 350 px decipher-archive scan (square-on, 350×490) is the printed face used as src. Lore matches both scans. Copyright 1995 legible. No V<N> remake; modern = Virtual Block 1 only (VB1 -pre, 350 px).
